desc:
🎮 Welcome to 2248! 🎮

🔢 Merge identical blocks to reach the infinite tile!
💥 Swipe blocks in any direction to combine numbers and trigger explosive combos!

How to Play
👉 Swipe: Move blocks up, down, left, right, or diagonally.
🔄 Merge: Combine like numbers to form higher values.
🤔 Plan: Think ahead for big moves.
🏆 Compete: Beat your score and climb the leaderboards.

Features
👍 Easy Gameplay: Quick to learn, hard to master.
✨ Sleek Design: Enjoy smooth, minimalistic visuals.
⏳ No Time Limits: Play at your own pace.
🌍 Global Leaderboards: Challenge players worldwide.

🔔 Play now 2248: Merge Number Puzzle now and join our community for updates and fun!

👍 If you like the game please consider giving a thumbs up and a favorite!
